title: 第2089章 九天十地来人第2088章 萧天流口水
content_zh:
一阵微风吹来，一股凉意也是惊醒了两个美人！
“啊......”
两道清脆的声音响起。
随后两个美人也是快速蹲下。
这个时候，黄鸢红着脸说道“夫君你怎么神出鬼没的，来也不说一下，害得我.....都被你看光了！”
“嘻嘻.....这有什么的，你们身上还有哪里是我没有看过的？”萧天得意的说道。
这话也是没有丝毫的毛病。
正如萧天所说，黄鸢和黄莺的肉身，早已经被萧天研究得明明白白的。
在萧天面前遮掩没有任何的意义。
“话...话是这么说，但人家还是会害羞的嘛！”黄鸢红着脸说道。
“这样呀！好办！”萧天笑着说道。
而听到萧天的话，黄鸢和黄莺心中也是一愣，不明白自己的这个男人这话是什么意思。然后就是一脸好奇的看着萧天。
下一刻，她们也是瞬间反应过来，然后脸色也是瞬间变得通红。
只见萧天瞬间脱下长袍，眨眼间就是赤裸裸的站在了两个人的面前然后贱贱的笑着说道“这样不就好嘛！咱们扯平都不吃亏！”
萧天说完之后还骄傲的挺起胸膛。
随着他的动作，天赋异禀的他就更加的明显了！
对此两个女人也是彻底无语了！
当然了，此刻黄鸢和黄莺的心中也是大为震惊！
然后两人也是对视了一眼！
“姐姐，你发现了没有，夫君的战力好像变得更加的强大了！”黄鸢红着脸说道。

“嗯，妹妹说的是那一方面！”黄鸢也是红着脸说道。
其实两个人的想法那叫一个心照不宣了！
“嗯，应该就是你想的那一方面！”黄鸢说道。
“那应该就是了！确实变得更加的强大了！真没想到，夫君的战力在这个时候居然还能成长！真的太神奇了。”黄鸢也是说道。
“虽然早就知道夫君有这样的能力，但再次见到还是感到无比的震撼！”黄莺也是说道。
对于这一点萧天的女人都是非常的清楚，但即便是清楚，但每一次看到都觉得不可思议。
要知道有多少男人想让自己这一方面的战力变得强大，但都是求而不得。
即便是萧天推出的丹药，提升的战力还是有限。当然了，有提升就已经是非常的难得了。所以，这些丹药还是非常的畅销的。其中一大部分还都是女人过来购买，很显然是满足不了需求，需要让自己的道侣变得更加的强大。
特别是随着有关萧天渡劫的留影石不断的疯狂传播，更是让众多的女修认识到自己的男人到底是有多大的差距。
强烈的反差自然是让那些女修变得更加的不满了。
每一次有关萧天名声的传播都会让萧天炼制的丹药爆火。
此刻，诸天万界之中，能够购买到萧天出品的龙华大还丹可是极少。
毕竟天宝商会还只是在玄黄宇宙以及附近的几个宇宙发展。
当然了，随着时机的成熟，天宝商会还是会向着外面发展的。
比较如今天逆宗越发的强大，资源的需求自然是更加的庞大。
要是都消耗神珠世界里面的也不是长久之计。
神珠世界之中的资源都是最顶级的，只有修为强大，对天逆宗有着重大贡献的强者才有资格购买。
没错，刚刚加入天逆宗的强者是连购买资格都没有的。
不过这也很正常，这种稀缺的资源怎么可能会大范围的派送。
要知道，从神珠世界出品的东西，随便一种到拍卖会上那都是压轴宝物的存在。

可想知，神珠世界的宝物到底是有多珍贵。
那平时宗门消耗的资源自然是需要宗门下面的产业来支撑！
content_en:
A breeze blew, and a coolness woke up the two beauties!
"Ah..."
Two crisp voices sounded.
Then the two beauties also squatted down quickly.
At this time, Huang Yuan blushed and said, "Husband, why are you so mysterious and invisible, and you don't even say anything when you come, which makes me...have all been seen by you!"
"Hehe... What's this? Is there anything else about you that I haven't seen?" Xiao Tian said proudly.
There is nothing wrong with this statement.
As Xiao Tian said, the physical bodies of Huang Yuan and Huang Ying have already been clearly studied by Xiao Tian.
There is no point in hiding it in front of Xiao Tian.
"That's what I say, but people are still shy!" Huang Yuan said with a blushing face.
"That's it! It's easy to handle!" Xiao Tian said with a smile.
When Huang Yuan and Huang Ying heard Xiao Tian's words, they were stunned, not knowing what their man meant. Then he looked at Xiao Tian with curiosity.
The next moment, they reacted instantly, and then their faces instantly turned red.
I saw Xiao Tian take off his robe in an instant, and in the blink of an eye he was standing naked in front of the two people. Then he said with a mean smile, "Isn't this good! Even if we are even, we won't suffer any loss!"
After Xiao Tian finished speaking, he puffed up his chest proudly.
As he moves, his talent becomes even more obvious!
The two women were completely speechless about this!
Of course, Huang Yuan and Huang Ying were also shocked at this moment!
Then the two of them also looked at each other!
"Sister, have you noticed that my husband's combat power seems to have become stronger!" Huang Yuan said with a blushing face.
"Well, that's what my sister is talking about!" Huang Yuan said with a blush.
In fact, the two people’s thoughts are tacitly understood!
"Well, it should be what you think about!" Huang Yuan said.
"That should be it! He has indeed become more powerful! I didn't expect that my husband's combat power could actually grow at this time! It's really amazing." Huang Yuan also said.
"Although I have long known that my husband has such an ability, I am still extremely shocked when I see him again!" Huang Ying also said.
Xiao Tian's women are very clear about this, but even though they are clear, they find it incredible every time they see it.
You must know how many men want to become stronger in this aspect of their combat power, but they all fail to achieve it.
Even with the elixir Xiao Tian launched, the improvement in combat power is still limited. Of course, improvement is already very rare. Therefore, these pills are still very popular. Most of them are bought by women. Obviously, they cannot meet the demand and need to make their Taoist companions stronger.
Especially as the picture stone about Xiao Tian's Tribulation continued to spread wildly, many female cultivators realized how far behind their men were.
The strong contrast naturally made the female cultivators even more dissatisfied.
Every time there is news about Xiao Tian's reputation, the pills refined by Xiao Tian will become popular.
At this moment, there are very few people in the world who can buy the Longhua Great Return Pill produced by Xiao Tian.
After all, Tianbao Chamber of Commerce has only developed in Xuanhuang Universe and several nearby universes.
Of course, as the time matures, Tianbao Chamber of Commerce will still develop outward.
Compared with today's Nishi Sect, which is becoming more and more powerful, the demand for resources is naturally greater.
It would not be a long-term solution if everything in the world of divine beads was consumed.
The resources in the world of Divine Pearls are top-notch, and only those with strong cultivation and significant contributions to the Tianni Sect are eligible to purchase them.
That's right, the strong man who just joined the Tianni Sect is not even qualified to purchase.
But this is normal. How can such scarce resources be distributed on a large scale?
You know, things produced from the world of divine beads,Any kind of it will be the final treasure at the auction.
One can only imagine how precious the treasures in the world of divine beads are.
The resources that the sect usually consumes naturally need to be supported by the industries under the sect!
